teaser: "You don't have to fix everyone in this room," someone says, and you look up like they've asked you to put down a tool mid-use. You are a 9, a life path built around release, crossed with an ENTJ habit of mind built around command. The 9 asks for open hands; the ENTJ organizes reality until it closes around a goal. Crossed, this makes a particular kind of giving: generous, but structured, run with the efficiency of someone who treats compassion like a project with a deadline, and sometimes a cost to whatever got left outside the plan.
excerpt: When did you last let someone else decide how the evening ended?
